Rich already has orange colours. You can use a named colour such as `orange1`, `orange3` or `dark_orange` in markup, for example `[orange1]text[/]`, or as a style, for example `Text("text", style="orange1")`. The full list is on the [colours page](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/appendix/colors.rst). If that does not cover what you need, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
